name: Moonrank Integration
author: moonrankai

sections.description:
Grow Organic Traffic Without Lifting a Finger.

Moonrank is your AI-powered content engine. It researches keywords, writes SEO-optimized articles, and publishes them straight to your WordPress site — automatically. No brainstorming, no writing, no scheduling. Just consistent growth on autopilot.

Built for businesses that want to rank on Google and AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.

The plugin connects securely to the Moonrank platform via a webhook endpoint, allowing published content to flow directly into your site.

Features:

  1. Automated content creation and keyword research — discover untapped keyword opportunities and publish optimized articles daily.
  2. Rank on Google and AI search — content is structured to perform on traditional search and AI-powered engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.
  3. One-click WordPress integration — set it up once, and new articles appear on your site automatically.
  4. SEO-ready articles with rich media — includes internal links, images, featured images, schema markup, and credible citations.
  5. Yoast SEO and RankMath compatible — meta titles, descriptions, and focus keywords are set automatically.
  6. Long-form, evergreen content — in-depth articles designed to rank and convert.
  7. Smart daily publishing schedule — a tailored content plan to keep fresh articles flowing consistently.
  8. Multi-site support — scale your content strategy across multiple WordPress sites from one Moonrank dashboard.

How it works:

  1. Install and activate this plugin
  2. Go to Settings > Moonrank to generate your integration key
  3. Copy the webhook URL and key into your Moonrank dashboard
  4. Articles published in Moonrank will automatically appear in WordPress

Privacy

This plugin registers a REST API webhook endpoint on your WordPress site. It receives data from the Moonrank platform when you publish articles. When articles include a featured image URL, the plugin downloads that image to your WordPress media library using WordPress core functions. No other data is sent to external servers. The plugin does not collect analytics or set tracking cookies.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the moonrank-integration folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Navigate to Settings > Moonrank
  4. Click “Generate Key” to create your integration key
  5. Copy the webhook URL and integration key to your Moonrank dashboard
sections.faq:
Do I need a Moonrank account?

Yes. Visit moonrank.ai to sign up for an account.

Is the integration secure?

Yes. Integration keys are bcrypt-hashed before storage – the plaintext key is never saved. All communication uses HTTPS. Rate limiting prevents abuse.

Does it work with Yoast SEO or RankMath?

Yes. The plugin automatically detects Yoast SEO and RankMath and sets the appropriate meta fields (meta description, meta title, focus keyword).

What happens if I regenerate the key?

The old key is immediately invalidated. You will need to update the key in your Moonrank dashboard.

My security plugin is blocking requests

If you use Wordfence, Sucuri, or similar security plugins, you may need to whitelist the /wp-json/moonrank/v1/article endpoint.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Secure webhook endpoint with bcrypt key hashing
  • Post create, update, and delete via webhook
  • Yoast SEO and RankMath meta field support
  • Category and tag management
  • Featured image sideloading with alt text
  • Rate limiting (60 requests/minute)
  • Admin settings page with one-time key display
